relationship.purpose: re-measure interface complexity after target repair rather than transferring the clean-teacher P0/P2 result by assumption
relationship.architecture_line: repository Residual-MLP recursive hierarchy with the exact C68E repaired-teacher recipe

H: The C68E robust-training repair changes the shifted teacher boundary geometry enough that the minimum reduced teacher-correction dimension at sigma=.36 may differ from the clean-teacher P0 frontier; a fresh ordered P0/P1/P2/P4/P8/P16 comparison against a strong P32 reference can detect that change while separately safeguarding target and reference validity.
T: Use fresh model seeds 67400-67415 and verification seed 67300. Reproduce the exact C68E 50%-Gaussian-augmentation teacher recipe at sigma=.36. Build the same recursive hierarchy from that repaired teacher's clean-training activations, then on a fixed 192-sample shifted calibration subset construct one canonical nested QR basis of teacher residuals. Evaluate P0, P1, P2, P4, P8, P16 and P32 on the same shifted validation tensor; P32 is the locked strong reference, not an assumption of exact/full reconstruction.
D: Stop if target validity or P32 reference validity fails. Otherwise candidate Pk passes only if both its validation non-inferiority versus P32 and its NMSE-ratio versus P32 pass. Select the smallest passing candidate only when the ordered candidate pass pattern is monotone (all larger tested candidate dimensions also pass); a later failure after an earlier pass stops as nonmonotonic. Any selected candidate advances only to a separate fresh C70R confirmation.
C: Robust training may change teacher residual geometry so strongly that P32 is not a valid reference; the reference-validity gate must then stop the experiment.
The repaired teacher may fail to reproduce C68E target validity on the new cohort; that is a target-validity failure rather than an interface result.
A nonmonotonic dimension pass pattern may reflect optimization sensitivity or finite-cohort variability rather than a scalar interface frontier.
The clean-trained teacher's P0 result may have depended on its specific boundary geometry and need not transfer to the repaired teacher.
U: P32 is a strong protocol reference but is not claimed to be a mathematically full 64-dimensional residual reconstruction.
The dimension grid is discrete and cannot establish an untested dimension or a universal minimum.
The Gaussian sigma=.36 shift and one repaired-teacher recipe define the scope; independent shift directions and other robust-training recipes may differ.
All candidate-selection results are exploratory until a separate fresh C70R confirmation.

repaired_teacher.source_recipe: exact C68E paired teacher-training implementation; augmented teacher is the target and the paired clean-only teacher may be co-trained only to preserve exact recipe/provenance

hierarchy.construction_inputs: clean training activations of the repaired augmented teacher
hierarchy.construction: same C61R-C68E four TinyRes(64,8) locals -> two retrained pairs -> two TinyRes(64,16) compressors -> Chain
hierarchy.exact_parameter_budget_invariant: 4096 trainable scalar parameters at each recursive level

shift_and_calibration.type: additive iid Gaussian input noise clipped to [0,1]

interface_conditions.basis: one canonical nested QR basis of shifted-calibration repaired-teacher residual transpose; every positive dimension uses the same prefix basis
interface_conditions.P0: frozen base recursive hierarchy compiled directly; no teacher residual correction and no top-boundary adaptation
interface_conditions.Pk_positive: project shifted-calibration teacher residual onto first k canonical QR columns, add the correction to frozen base output, adapt the top hierarchy boundary for 600 updates, then compile
interface_conditions.P32_role: locked strong reference condition; validity is tested prospectively and P32 is not described as exact/full reconstruction

adaptation_and_compilation.top_adaptation_seed_rule: model_seed + 695000, shared across every positive dimension within a seed
adaptation_and_compilation.compiled_final_init_seed_rule: model_seed + 696000, shared across all dimensions within a seed
adaptation_and_compilation.compiled_final_fit_seed_rule: model_seed + 697000, shared across all dimensions within a seed

eligibility.eligible_seed_if: repaired teacher and hierarchy construction complete, exact recursive parameter-budget invariant holds, all required metrics are finite, every condition NMSE is positive, and all locked provenance/integrity assertions hold

target_task_validity.statistic: paired repaired-teacher shifted minus repaired-teacher clean validation accuracy
target_task_validity.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -20.0 percentage points

p32_reference_validity.statistic: paired P32 final-replacement shifted-validation accuracy minus repaired-teacher shifted-validation accuracy
p32_reference_validity.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -5.0 percentage points

validation_noninferiority.statistic: paired candidate Pk minus P32 shifted-validation accuracy
validation_noninferiority.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -2.0 percentage points

nmse_ratio.statistic: geometric mean of paired candidate-Pk / P32 activation-NMSE ratios

rules: else if target-task validity fails: STOP_ROBUST_TARGET_INVALID
else if P32 reference validity fails: STOP_P32_REFERENCE_INVALID
else if a candidate passes and any larger tested candidate later fails: STOP_NONMONOTONIC_DIMENSION_FRONTIER
else select the smallest passing candidate whose entire larger-candidate suffix also passes and return ADVANCE_P<k>_TO_C70R
else if no reduced candidate P0/P1/P2/P4/P8/P16 passes: NO_REDUCED_CANDIDATE_THROUGH_P16

bootstrap.method: paired model-seed percentile 95%; one common bootstrap index matrix reused for target validity, P32 reference validity and every candidate gate

analysis_boundary.scope: exact C69E repaired-teacher Residual-MLP at Gaussian sigma=.36 only
not_supported_even_if_candidate_selected: the selected dimension is a universal minimum
